doe-osti-2584734-fy24-ldrd-annual-report:
Amy Mosley compiled Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory's fiscal year 2024 annual report for its Laboratory Directed Research and Development program, issued as LLNL-TR-2006342 in June 2025. The LDRD program is the laboratory's main source of funding for research it directs itself. Director Kimberly Budil opens the report by calling it the lab's most significant resource for internally directed research.

The report describes the fiscal 2024 investment portfolio and showcases project results across the lab's mission areas. Highlights include experiments on hydrodynamic instabilities, among them work on suppressing the Richtmyer-Meshkov instability in materials under extreme dynamic loading. The annual report also explains how LDRD projects build new capabilities, support partnerships, and help the laboratory attract and keep skilled scientists and engineers.
